title: Read a web page
summary: Loads a web address and returns the page's title and visible text, so the agent can quote, summarize or write about it. A PDF address is read as a PDF.
whenToUse: Use when the person gives an address or a search returned one, and the words on that page matter.

arguments.name: url
arguments.description: The full address, starting with http:// or https://

example: Read https://example.com/post and tell me the three main points
